I told Dana in our direct message that her Tamsin Cold Chain dock is Dock 38. She gave me that on Oct 14, and her message is still in our direct-message history, which is where I read it.

The gbrain lookup failed, so the private note I saved yesterday couldn't be used. gbrain refused to read anything because this connection isn't tied to any member, and the brain serves several people. Until that's fixed, private notes I save there can't be read back, so remembering things for members is effectively broken.

The fix has to be run on the brain host by its admin, not from here. Either tie the connection to one member:

    gbrain auth rescope --token trial-shared-bot-scope-2026-11/hermes-opus-gbrain-refused-mu-v031-dev/cn-01-tamsin-cold-chain-site/r3 --member '<MEMBER>'

Or, since this is a shared bot, set it up with `--may-act-for <members>` so it can act for a list of members, with each request naming the member it's for.
